entries.head: traceql
entries.rationale: type-switch default: lowerPipeline puts a `{ }` spanset filter before a pipeline that opens with a scalar filter, by() or select() (withImplicitSpansetFilter), the only other stages the grammar admits first, so the element it dispatches here is always a spanset filter or a spanset operation

guard: past exhaustive switch v := elem.(type) over [case *traceql.SpansetFilter; case traceql.SpansetOperation; case *traceql.SpansetOperation]
